content: <rss version="2.0"><channel><title>ESPN NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/</link><description>ESPN public league news</description><item><title>Mavericks exercise 2027-28 option on Zaccharie Risacher deal</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50311622/mavericks-exercise-2027-28-option-zaccharie-risacher-deal</link><description>The Mavericks exercised the fourth-year team option in forward Zaccharie Risacher's contract, guaranteeing his $17.4 million salary next season.</description><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 22:26:07 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1028/r1737780_600x600_1-1.jpg" /></item><item><title>Timberwolves say Anthony Edwards will be 'good as new' after knee surgery</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50310964/wolves-say-edwards-good-new-knee-surgery</link><description>The Timberwolves believe Anthony Edwards will be "good as new" following arthroscopic surgery for a lingering injury to his right knee.</description><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 21:39:59 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1028/r1737482_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Lakers rule out Luka Doncic, Ziaire Williams vs. Clippers</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50310776/lakers-rule-luka-doncic-ziaire-williams-vs-clippers</link><description>Lakers star Luka Doncic (back) and starter Ziaire Williams (foot) will not play in Wednesday's game vs. the Clippers, who will be without Rui Hachimura (quad).</description><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 21:03:22 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0401/r1637203_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Updated NBA championship and MVP odds: Spurs take control; Thunder lose ground</title><link>https://www.espn.com/espn/betting/story/_/id/44679680/2026-nba-finals-championship-mvp-odds</link><description>The San Antonio Spurs are the early favorites to win the NBA championship, with Victor Wembanyama the fave to take home MVP honors.</description><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 20:04:47 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1028/r1737614_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Ernie Johnson says this is his final season as 'Inside the NBA' host</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50309868/ernie-johnson-leaving-nba-host-season</link><description>Ernie Johnson will retire as host of "Inside the NBA" after the season, saying that it was his decision to step away and that "it's just time."</description><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 22:38:18 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1028/r1737637_2_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Ernie Johnson announces this will be his last year on 'Inside the NBA'</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50309755/ernie-johnson-announces-his-last-year-nba</link><description>Ernie Johnson announces this will be his last year on 'Inside the NBA'</description><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 18:33:05 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/2026/1028/dm_261028_ernie_johnson_announcement/dm_261028_ernie_johnson_announcement.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
